# Project README

A small open-source library for parsing configuration files.

## Installation

Run the installer and follow the prompts. You must accept the license
agreement before continuing.

## Usage

Import the module and call `load_config(path)`. The function returns a dict.

## Notes

- We respect your privacy and never share your data.
- Report issues on the issue tracker and our team will follow up.
- The build badge shows the latest test status.

Thanks for using the project. We appreciate your feedback.
